correctness.rationale: The specified U columns are orthonormal and each row product-squared is 1/16; independent Bernoulli covariance ratios give every B_ab=(h+ell)/2. Orthogonal E+/E- reduction yields minus corrected eigenvalue beta-(h-ell)K_-/(2nu), K_-~Bin(2nu,1/2); exact failure is K_->=nu(kappa+1)/(kappa-1). It is absent for all samples exactly for 1<kappa<3, with singularity at equality. Raw PD is K_+>0,K_->0, yielding joint probability (1-4^-nu)q. Fusion minus eigenvalue scaled by ell is (kappa+1)+[theta-(kappa-1)]K_-/nu; extremal K_-=2nu gives iff theta>(kappa-3)/2. Frobenius variances (h^2+ell^2)/(2nu) and (h-ell)^2/(4nu), CLT threshold 2sqrt2/c and Cramer exponent follow from exact binomial. Independently enumerated all 16 one-sketch outcomes at h=7,l=1: 4 bad corrected, 3 bad corrected with good raw, 9 raw good.
residual_risks: Finite independent checks are corroborative; unrestricted theorem rests on mathematical reductions and exact certificates, not samples.
